image_location_description: Bottom of model under the feet; small rectangular stand for stability (not shown).

steps.title: Bottom row 2
steps.description: Add 2x 3002 Black bricks behind to complete a 6x4 base.

steps.title: Top plate layer start
steps.description: Add 2x 3021 DarkBluishGray plates (2x3) covering the front half.

steps.title: Finish top plate layer
steps.description: Add 3021 DBG (2x3), 3022 DBG (2x2), 3023 DBG (1x2) to fill 6x4.

steps.title: Edge tiles (sides)
steps.description: Add 2x 2431 LightBluishGray tiles (1x4) along left/right edges.

steps.title: Edge tiles (ends)
steps.description: Add 2x 2431 LBG (1x4) on front/back + 2x 3069b LBG (1x2) to close gaps.

steps.title: Foot position jumpers
steps.description: Place 2x 3795 DarkBluishGray jumper plates in the center for stance.
